### Describe the problem

> Provide a clear and concise description of the issue

### What was the expected behavior?

> Tell us about the behavior you expected to see

### Reproduction

> Detail the steps taken to reproduce this error, and whether this issue can be reproduced
> consistently or if it is intermittent.
> **Note**: If clear, reproducible steps or the smallest sample app demonstrating misbehavior
> cannot be provided, we may not be able to follow up on this bug report.

- Step 1..
- Step 2..
- ...

> Where applicable, please include:
>
> - The smallest possible sample app that reproduces the undesirable behavior
> - Log files (redact/remove sensitive information — never paste your Auth Key)
> - Screenshots or a screen recording

### Environment

> Please provide the following:

- **UI Kit artifact and version:** <!-- e.g. com.cometchat:chatuikit-kotlin-android:6.0.7 -->
- **Toolkit:** <!-- Views (chatuikit-kotlin) or Jetpack Compose (chatuikit-compose) -->
- **Calls SDK version, if used:** <!-- e.g. com.cometchat:calls-sdk-android:5.0.2, or "not used" -->
- **Android version(s) and device(s):** <!-- e.g. Android 15, Pixel 8; Android 10, emulator -->
- **compileSdk / minSdk of your app:**
- **Build type:** <!-- debug, or release with R8/ProGuard enabled -->
- **Other libraries that might be involved:**
